paths.name: Issuer-backed redeemable unit
paths.userJob: Let a known issuer sell and redeem a stable-value claim while Kaspa records payments and redemptions.
paths.mechanism: Issuer maintains reserves and honors redemption records.
paths.custodyModel: Issuer custody and legal redemption promise.
paths.firstSafeArtifact: Issuer/redemption state machine backed by accepted payload receipts, with no native-stablecoin claim.
paths.next: Tie one mock issuer redemption to accepted payload state before any product language.

paths.name: Overcollateralized vault unit
paths.userJob: Borrow a stable unit against volatile collateral with visible health and liquidation risk.
paths.mechanism: Collateral vault plus mint/burn accounting and liquidation rules.
paths.custodyModel: Script/vProg-controlled collateral later; simulator only now.
paths.firstSafeArtifact: Collateral health simulator with manual price inputs and no minting.
paths.next: Build a non-custodial risk calculator before any settlement design.

paths.name: Synthetic index unit
paths.userJob: Track a dollar-like value synthetically without promising redemption.
paths.mechanism: Oracle-indexed accounting or contract-for-difference style exposure.
paths.custodyModel: Counterparty or future programmable settlement; not safe as a payment unit yet.
paths.firstSafeArtifact: Simulation-only index dashboard that shows oracle and margin failure modes.
paths.next: Keep as research; do not position it as a stablecoin or merchant rail.

paths.name: External stablecoin rail
paths.userJob: Use an existing stablecoin elsewhere while Kaspa handles fast payment proofs or app receipts.
paths.mechanism: External asset remains on its source rail; Kaspa indexes payment intents, receipts, or claims.
paths.custodyModel: External chain/issuer/bridge risk, not Kaspa-native custody.
paths.firstSafeArtifact: Bridge/source-chain checklist and receipt mapper, without custody or wrapped-asset issuance.
paths.next: Add this to the ZK/anchor checklist before any bridge or wrapped-stable claim.

boundaries: This is a stable-value comparison brief, not a live stablecoin design.
Issuer-backed paths can be modeled with accepted receipts now, but they depend on issuer/legal redemption trust.
Overcollateralized, synthetic, and bridge paths require oracle, liquidity, custody, and settlement assumptions before product claims.
Do not call anything here Kaspa-native until asset issuance, redemption, and enforcement are proven with accepted transaction state or future covenant/vProg rails.
